atoms.text: The mouse deer was well-known for her tricks. “I’m lucky that I’m so clever because many animals want to eat me, but they never can! I always outsmart them.” Today, she was going to find out just how clever she was.

instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: The mouse deer was eating quietly in the bushes when she heard a sound. She froze, trying to sense the danger. Suddenly, a tiger stepped out from his hiding spot.
atoms.sound: ssml: The mouse deer was eating quietly in the bushes when she heard a sound. She froze, trying to sense the danger. Suddenly, a tiger stepped out from his hiding spot.

atoms.text:
“I see you mouse deer, and now I will eat you!” said the hungry tiger.

The mouse deer thought fast and scanned the surrounding area. “You can’t eat me. The king has told me to guard his pudding,” said the mouse deer, pointing at a muddy puddle on the ground.

atoms.text:
The tiger thought himself very important, and if something was good enough for the king, then it was certainly good for him too. The tiger let the mouse deer go and tasted the ‘pudding'.

He spit it out and roared, “You tricked me! Now I am really going to eat you.”
